verified: D-21: every number on the news panel and legacy screen is a DisplayBinding or ComposedBinding. The header uses ComposedBinding from consequence.news.slots.news_epoch and news_age_years; the body is one DisplayBinding on consequence.news; the closing line is one ComposedBinding from clock.tau and clock.t; the three label CopyBindings hold a fixed map (raw->copy). The lint rejects any digit outside a slot in templates and any digit in labels or reason phrases. The display audit (DisplayBinding.audit) is the positive control: a hand-set number on the panel fails the audit (test_renderings).

Legacy closing line is purely formatted, no GDScript arithmetic: legacy_screen.gd compose([labels['legacy_away'], ['clock.tau', FMT], labels['legacy_older'], ['clock.t', FMT], labels['legacy_tail']]) and ComposedBinding.update_from concatenates format_field results. test_legacy_line checks the sim's two clocks, and the gap_years field is deliberately different (7.56 vs the second number 8.80) so a client that subtracts would fail.

AC3: Begin again is a new voyage on the running sim with a new seed. legacy_screen.gd:begin_again calls sim.new_game(s, 'sol', false, Transit.new_game_params()) and clears entries/rows/visible. The session test asserts sim.last_seed == 12345 != old_seed, tick 0, journey state idle, no news, no legacy, diagnostics empty. The grep half of AC3 is asserted in test_legacy_line by a regex over the new screens: 'no save or load path in the new screens' — the regex finds no save_game|load_game|ResourceSaver in legacy_screen.gd, composed_binding.gd, or news_panel.gd.

D-8: AI request is gated. news_panel.gd:request_ai refuses unless relay.enabled AND relay.mode not in ['off','replay'] AND relay.route_for('text') != ''. test_request_policy asserts: AI on with a key — one request, never twice; AI off (mode 'off') — nothing is asked; no key for text — nothing is asked; an item that already has ai_request_id — not asked again. With no key the template stands, no notice, no AI request.

AC6 (display half): the three provenance renderings are wired and snapshot-tested. The sim decides, the panel never overrides. test_renderings checks template (no tag, no notice), ai (the accepted text, the 'generated' tag), fallback (the notice, the reason in words from the table, the template paragraph, one diagnostics line). An 'ai' body_source without an accepted text is a loud error, not a silent template; a 'template' body_source ignores any text seen. The sim-side checkBodySourceThreePaths asserts the same three paths in consequence_test.ail on one arrival.

No replay golden or protocol digest changed. git diff 4689442..e5dd64b touches no file under tests/replays/, sim/protocol.ail, or sim/ai.ail. The parity sha256 (1e9413ef538f0b0a) matches tests/replays/diag_thrust600.state.arm64.sha256; the strict protocolVm digest (0c5fb7da24b065de) reproduces.

explicit_answers.1_numbers_unbound_D21: No. Every number on the news panel and the legacy screen is a binding. The header and closing line use ComposedBinding (format_field only); the body is one DisplayBinding on consequence.news; the three label CopyBindings carry a fixed raw->copy map. The lint rejects digits in copy.json labels and in templates outside slots; the display audit is the positive control (a hand-set number fails the audit). The 'always at most 280 characters' cap on a filled template is enforced at the worst-case slot width and the bodySource fallback path renders the same template (no client arithmetic).
explicit_answers.2_legacy_closing_line: Yes. legacy_screen.gd composes the closing line as [labels['legacy_away'], ['clock.tau', FMT], labels['legacy_older'], ['clock.t', FMT], labels['legacy_tail']] and ComposedBinding.update_from concatenates format_field results. No subtraction. test_legacy_line makes the gap_years field deliberately different (7.56) from the sim's t (8.80) so a client-side subtraction would show 7.56 and fail the audit. test_session confirms the live sim values: 'You were away %.2f years. Home is %.2f years older.' with tau and t from the sim.
explicit_answers.3_begin_again_AC3: Yes. legacy_screen.gd:begin_again calls sim.new_game(s, 'sol', false, Transit.new_game_params()) with a new seed (the test injects next_seed=12345, the executor's run shows 12345 != old_seed, and the s += 1 guard prevents a same-seed collision). The session test asserts: tick 0, journey state 'idle', no news, no legacy entries, screens closed, panel diagnostics empty. The regex half of AC3 (no save_game|load_game|ResourceSaver in the new screens) is asserted by the test itself.
explicit_answers.4_template_path_no_key_D8: Yes. request_ai refuses unless relay.enabled AND relay.mode not in ['off','replay'] AND relay.route_for('text') != ''. test_request_policy: AI off (mode 'off') — nothing is asked, the template stands; no key for text — nothing is asked; an item with ai_request_id already set — not asked again. The session test runs the template path with no key as the default and never opens a relay.
explicit_answers.5_replay_or_protocol_changed: No. No file under tests/replays/ is touched. sim/protocol.ail is untouched. The strict protocolVm digest (0c5fb7da24b065de, 17 lines) reproduces; the parity diag_thrust600 sha256 (1e9413ef538f0b0a) matches the golden.
explicit_answers.6_size_justified: Mostly yes, with a note. Code (gd) is 545 lines and tests are 332+13 lines — 890 lines against the design's 250+100=350 estimate (2.5x). The sprint JSON's loc_cap is 650; the code alone is below the cap, but code+tests exceed it by 1.4x. The overrun is not unrequested: lint, snapshot fixtures, the display audit positive control, AI gating, the reason table, the three renderings, the end-to-end session, the S4 review sheet, and the CHANGELOG are all in the design or implied by 'tests first' and S4. No new internal systems were added; no unrelated code was refactored. The executor should have revised the estimate or sought a waiver, but the work is justified by the scope. Deducted -1 from code quality.
